no_results_title: No results found for the current filters.
initial_prompt: Click on the map or search for a location to begin.
initial_dialog_desc: You can adjust the filters to find biomass sources. Click anywhere on the map to change your search center.
help_desc_p1: Biomass Mapper is a tool designed to help you locate and visualize biomass sources on an interactive map. You can search for specific locations, filter by type of biomass, and adjust the search radius to find the resources you need.
help_desc_p2: Use the filters in the side panel to refine your search. The results will be displayed both in a list and on the map. You can click on any point on the map to get more details about a specific biomass source.
